# Aalto near-field HRTF attribution

`NF_LIB_HRTF_LFE.sofa` is from the Aalto University near-field HRTF database,
Zenodo DOI [10.5281/zenodo.7316545](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7316545).

Creators: Sebastian Prepelita, Javier Gomez Bolanos, Ville Pulkki, and Marton
Marschall. The dataset is licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The SOFA metadata identifies the related publication as
[Near-field head-related transfer functions of human subjects and a head and torso simulator](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apacoust.2022.109173).
